# Cheese for the Road

*Harra is sending a wheel of her best cheese to Corwell, who will pretend it is too dear. Take it to him, and hunt 30 Ridge Stumps on the South Path on the way.*

## Objectives

- Defeat 30 [Ridge Stump](../monsters/ridge_stump.md) in [The South Path](../maps/south_path.md)
- Deliver 1 [Harra's Cheese Wheel](../items/harra_cheese_wheel.md)

## Rewards

- 1,750 EXP
- 320 mesos
- [Travel Ration](../items/travel_ration.md) x10
- +20 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Harra](../npcs/harra_tolmach.md)
